title: Shadowspeed
summary: Shadowspeed is a spell which allows the caster to move at extreme speeds for a few seconds. A similar spell to Nimblefire, Shadowspeed is used for quick bursts of speed as opposed to prolonged speed. It is commonly associated with members of the Organization.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Somewhere around the Seine River, Unnamed Suit 001 used Shadowspeed against Lok Lambert. The Suit managed to grab onto Lok's leg and toss him with the spell's aid, but Lok was able to land safely.[Into the River of Secrets]

While inside the Paris catacombs trying to get the Ring of Arc to a Huntik safehouse, Zhalia Moon cast this spell against Unnamed Suit 001, Ms. Thorpe and Mr. MacTavish. Under its effects, she managed to knock out the first with the help of Darksleep, as well as Thorpe and later, in conjunction with Mindsight, MacTavish. [Divide and Conquer]

On a one-on-one duel at the Sutos Island, Grier used this spell alongside Dante's Nimblefire. They both traded superhuman speed-punches for a brief moment. [Like Father, Unlike Son]
